title: Domains explicitly excluded from journal-health/v1 sync
description: These artifacts must never appear in SyncChange snapshots or remote operation logs.

excluded.name: daily
excluded.reason: Query projection derived from daily_metrics and meals; not a synchronizable fact.

excluded.name: routine
excluded.reason: Query projection derived from sleep_night and naps; not a synchronizable fact.

excluded.name: trends cache
excluded.reason: Ephemeral aggregated UI cache; recomputed from metric_day_snapshots.

excluded.name: app state
excluded.reason: Per-device UI and session preferences; not shared across replicas.

excluded.name: sqlite file
excluded.reason: Physical journal.sqlite must not be uploaded; only typed snapshots cross the wire.

excluded.name: finance
excluded.reason: Finance uses a separate contract and sync plan; v1 rejects finance payloads.

excluded.name: raw FIT
excluded.reason: Binary Garmin activity files stay on device; only normalized activity snapshots sync.

excluded.name: tokens
excluded.reason: Garmin SSO tokens, device enrollment secrets, and API credentials never sync.

excluded.name: journal/YYYY.json
excluded.reason: Legacy year files are not read or imported; excluded from all sync paths.

excluded.name: sync replica metadata
excluded.reason: sync_records, sync_cursor, sync_applied_ops are per-replica local state, not domain facts.
